title: HardeningRequest
description: Input to Stage 2. `screening_status` is copied from the upstream screening stage and is NOT judged here: the adapter only checks it against policy.yaml (approved / pending). Keys of `known_constraints` the module understands: environment (string), data_classification (string), already_enforced_control_ids (array of control ids enforced elsewhere), accepted_conflicts (array of recommended-control ids a human reviewer accepted). `conversation_context` is accepted and carried, but not interpreted in v0.1. Other keys are ignored.
